episodes.title: THERE ARE CULTISTS IN THE POLICE AND ARMY | Charles Paul Ejegwa | Outside the Box | Episode 81
episodes.description:
Are there cult members within Nigeria's security agencies? In this revealing conversation, the guest discusses the alleged presence of cultists within the police and military, sharing his perspective on how deeply cultism extends into different parts of society.

He also explains the hierarchy within cult groups, making a surprising distinction between street-initiated members and those initiated in higher institutions. According to him, some university-based cult members do not consider street cultists to be legitimate members.

Who really qualifies as a cultist, and how does this underground hierarchy work?

Watch the full conversation for more insights into cultism, initiation and its presence in Nigerian society.
